profile.name: Yalla Dhattatreya
profile.headline: AI Engineer
profile.introduction: I build Python applications and real-time solutions across computer vision, web development, and embedded systems.
profile.biography: I’m an aspiring AI Engineer and Python Developer with a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering from Srinivasa Institute of Engineering and Technology. I have hands-on project experience in Python, SQL, machine learning, and computer vision through projects such as a Sign Language Communication System and Brain Tumor Detection. I’m expanding my skills in backend development, AWS, and AI/LLM applications, with a focus on solving practical problems. As a recent graduate, I’m seeking an entry-level opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects and grow in AI and software development.

projects.title: Arduino-Based Radar System
projects.summary: Built an Arduino radar system that detects nearby objects with ultrasonic sensors and displays their position in real time.
projects.description: An embedded system combining Arduino, ultrasonic sensing, and real-time visualization for obstacle detection and monitoring.
projects.problem: Detect nearby objects and present their positions as sensor readings arrive.
projects.approach: Interfaced ultrasonic sensors with Arduino, processed readings in Embedded C, and visualized detected objects in real time.
projects.contribution: Developed the sensor interfacing, data processing, and real-time visualization.
projects.outcome: Demonstrated end-to-end hardware and software integration for obstacle monitoring.

projects.title: Sign Language Communication System
projects.summary: Developed a Python and OpenCV system that recognizes sign-language gestures and converts them into text or speech.
projects.description: An assistive communication system using image processing and machine-learning techniques for real-time gesture recognition.
projects.problem: Support communication between people who sign and people who do not sign.
projects.approach: Used Python, OpenCV, image processing, and machine-learning techniques to recognize gestures in real time.
projects.contribution: Developed the gesture recognition system and its text or speech output flow.
projects.outcome: Converted recognized gestures into text or speech to support communication.
